definition.simple: Judging what a company might be worth compared with the price you would pay for it.
definition.balanced: Simple valuation tools compare the price with profit, cash or dividends: [[pe-ratio|P/E]], earnings yield (EPS ÷ price) and [[dividend-yield]]. A good business can be a poor investment if the price already assumes more than it later delivers. Every valuation rests on guesses about the future.
